items.title: U.S. Home Sales Just Hit Their Lowest Level in 25 Years. Is the Housing Market Breaking?
items.summary: Contract signings have collapsed to a record low, yet prices have barely budged. Homebuilders are quietly absorbing the pain, and their margins reveal who is paying for a market where nobody wants to move.

items.title: Trump Calls Huang’s Exit “Such a Tragedy” as His Filing Shows Up to $380,000 of Nvidia Buys
items.summary: Key TakeawaysTrump’s September trading report shows up to $380,000 of Nvidia buys, plus Tesla and SpaceX, and sales of $1 million to $5 million each of Home Depot and McDonald’s. The White House says outside firms run the portfolio, and most of the month’s money went into a dividend ETF and municipal bonds.
